partition.numbering_basis: Ascending physical x; column is physical rank for a linear array, not connector signal.

operating_envelope.basis: Nominal burst envelope; not voltage high-state time, acoustic energy, temperature or cure.
operating_envelope.local_duty_basis: Maximum of configured burst/PRI and burst/shortest compiled same-role start interval lower bound, including group boundaries. With fewer than two starts, only the configured ratio is available. Nominal timing, not measured output.

timing.description: Scheduled lower bound, not an exact hardware period. Within-group TTNA includes acquisition time; only group-final explicit noops are added, with no pending TTNA at group boundaries. Final-acquisition execution, DMA, processing, command overhead and profile transitions may add time. Completion noops add the full effective duration after the acquisition event. All settle, recovery and recharge values are assumed; 5000 us cannot guarantee profile completion (D00163 Rev. K/L section 12.1 reports up to 6-8 ms).
timing.duty_cycle_basis: Per-supercycle nominal pulse time divided by the scheduled cycle lower bound; an upper estimate for that nominal timing model, not measured acoustic exposure, successful curing, or a clinical safety conclusion.

limitations: The current 64-linear baseline is user-reported working; dimensions/electrical limits are source-derived, not calibrated.
TINGSN Sonic Eyes 10F exact model suffix is unknown; P9-4ULts is a software alias.
Exposure parameters and profile settling/recovery times are assumed, not measured.
Profile 5 availability is unknown; no p5ena flag is forced.
Waveform/sampling quantization and buffer fit must be validated by VSX.
Finite software sequence does not measure acoustic energy, temperature or material cure.
Linear reconstruction and electronic focusing are limited to XZ; elevation lens behavior is not calibrated.
Synthetic matrix mode is retained for regression only and does not describe the current physical probe.
Odd/even means ascending physical x rank, not connector parity; sparse-aperture sidelobes/grating lobes are not validated.
Declared limits do not establish hardware qualification or measured acoustic/thermal safety.
